Hope Saldean is the adopted daughter of Farmer Saldean and his wife Salma. As a young girl, she wandered into the Saldeans' farmhouse and collapsed on the floor. As no one had any idea as to who she was or who her family was, and she appeared to have no recollection either, the Saldeans adopted her, naming her Hope ("for that is what she represented", as Salma Saldean relates it).

Hooktooth is a virmen that lives in the Valley of the Four Winds. After failing to buy carrots from Maraad, he and his group decided to try using different coins. Just above them, the dark shaman appear and the Warren Mother tried to use the same tactic to get carrots. Unfortunately they weren't friendly and Zertin killed her on the spot. Hooktooth has taken some form of leadership and orders the virmen to stay underground until they heard Mashok talking about how no more carrots will grow.

.]] Hopebreakers are the hunters of the venthyr. After demoralizing and terrorizing souls, they release them in order to hunt them down and finish the process of breaking their spirit, making them more pliable and producing more anima in the process. But to be a hopebreaker is to conquer all prey, not just souls, and as such they also kill the native beasts of the realm. Their usual territories are the Banewood, Wanecrypt Hill and the Stalker's Lodge. They usually hunt on their feet, using swords instead of ranged weapons.

The Frostwolf Howler is an wolf mount, only rideable by players of the Horde. The wolf is white with a red saddle and blue armor. It was formerly only available to players who had reached the exalted reputation with the Frostwolf Clan, but is now available to anyone who has the necessary honor. It may be interesting to note that the Frostwolf Clan was named after this creature and that these wolves have a great bond with shamans.
